body: Orchestrator decision (person confirmed, 2026-11-15): the installed-Windows proof uses a scratch variant of the NSIS installer that differs only in appId/productName, installed silently to a temp folder, verified, then uninstalled, because the real one-click installer (same appId com.davgor.darkmechanicus) would replace the running desktop app that hosts this run. Portable exe is run from a scratch folder as built. Also: DM-514 c2 runnable CLI examples are carried here (c8) and must be executed with a desktop-bound scratch grant.
